note: 24 h into the 96 h full-cocktail phase. The Boolean input vector is identical to the day-6 checkpoint -- a checkpoint is an OBSERVATION POSITION inside one continuous phase, never a protocol arm, and no condition cfg corresponds to it. NO SIMULATION TIME IS ASSIGNED: while calibrated_physical_time is false there is no position in the trajectory corresponding to '24 h into the phase', and every candidate rule for manufacturing one has been rejected. Proportional placement (0.25 of the relative duration) asserts 24 h per relative unit. Ordinal-rank placement (k/n of the phase) is unstable under extension: this reading would move from 1/2 of the trajectory to 1/4 the moment 48 h and 72 h are declared, so an unchanged observation would acquire a different simulated value because a different observation was declared. experimental_phase_fraction 0.25 is recorded because it is a fact about the EXPERIMENT, and is never multiplied by a MaBoSS horizon. What this checkpoint carries is its order and its metadata; what the model can be compared against is the phase-wide behaviour (see docs/observation_checkpoints.md).
